specimen-line.purpose: Actual loaded product face, up to 260px; wraps long literal input.

license-name.purpose: Shared role unchanged; preview values are demo.

shadows.purpose: Shared product slider; no homepage decorative shadow.

motion.name: home-specimen-motion
motion.purpose: Ready specimen settles; Graphics uses 24ms stagger. Reduced motion removes transitions/animations.

scope.homepage: index.html: style.css, editorial.css, home.css; body editorial home. G01 user-pinned blue/lime/rounded world.
scope.shared: product.html/catalog.html retain style.css/editorial.css, #2247c8 shared accent and 4px controls. Font/tester core unchanged.
scope.normativeTokens: DESIGN.md frontmatter. home-* roles are route-scoped, not global replacements.

homepage.opening: Integrated blue navigation, compact foundry intro, lime catalog action; dominant full-width actual editable type, controls/facts within default first viewport.
homepage.collectionGrid: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); one column mobile; complete 3:2 artwork
homepage.shape: 32px blue outer header / 40px light lower surface / 8px controls; mobile fields 24px

layout.product: Unchanged R06/R06A: gallery/summary 1.4fr 1fr, gap 52px; tester, license, Font information. Tester controls four/two/one columns, 4px corners.
layout.catalog: Unchanged native category/tag filters and product grid, 4px controls, shared Rule/Paper selected state.

specimen.loading: Dim sample, aria-busy and visible loading status; retain control access.
specimen.error: Hide sample but retain literal text, clear facts, expose same-cut Retry this cut.
specimen.race: Latest request only may mutate facts/face; failed in-flight promises are released for retry.
specimen.empty: Keep active face; prompt Your words is not saved visitor text.
specimen.longText: pre-wrap, overflow-wrap anywhere, visible overflow; field grows rather than clipping.

evidence.behaviorReport: G01 report and scratch logs own current runtime evidence, not old R05H PASS totals.
evidence.reviewReport: Read-only finish review pending parent arrangement.
evidence.approval: User visual acceptance and production approval remain separate. No new shipping raster.

components.name: Shared product tester controls
components.description: Unchanged textarea maxlength 300, real style select, size 16–200px, leading .8–2.6, tracking -.10–.30em, segmented alignment/theme, detected OpenType switches/glyph panel. Theme dark #101318/#f5f7fa, native focus and disabled states. Mondriel named OTF styles remain integrated on product; homepage introduces no new font-core mapping.

narrative.overview: G01 homepage is a working font poster: actual editable white specimen dominates an integrated blue field, lime actions/selection and a rounded white full-artwork collection follow. User-pinned direction replaces The Glazing Grid and seed e7218d38. Shared product/catalog world remains intact.
keyCharacteristics: Royal blue/white with lime action and selected states
Literal input preservation, same-cut retry, truthful font/Graphics search

rules.name: Homepage pinned palette
rules.body: Blue #0644df/deep #0335b4, white and lime #c4ff00. Overrides old homepage one-accent rule; shared accent remains #2247c8.

rules.name: Product Font Rule
rules.body: Only render product sample after real font success; failures hide sample without deleting visitor text. Unavailable collection sources use intact artwork.

rules.name: Price and rights truth
rules.body: Zero Graphics base values are not free-download/Extended-price evidence. Use See license options; label positive fixture values Demo.

dos: Keep editable type dominant and active facts in default first viewport
Retain literal input, race safeguards, native focus and reduced motion
Show whole 3:2 artwork and clear fixture disclosure
Preserve product/catalog source styles and font core
donts: No crypto, wallets, profiles, glass cards, fake stats or reference-layout clone
No invented face sources, rights, download buttons or public prices
No overflow clipping to conceal long-text defects
No global propagation of homepage lime/radius
No inference of user/production approval from tests
